entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is a complete piece of garbage. The pulse tracker is a joke. It said my heart rate was 180 while I was sitting on the couch!
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing trouble with the device. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the pulse sensor specifically?
It's a fault with the whole thing! I don't have time to play tech support with you people. I just want my money back. I want a refund, now.
I understand your frustration, and I want to help resolve this. Sometimes a quick software reset can recalibrate the sensor. If you have the band nearby, we could try that very quickly.

Are you kidding me? I told you, I don't have time for this! This is unacceptable. I want to speak to your manager right now! I'm a VIP member, and I'll be leaving reviews everywhere about this garbage product.

Please, there's no need for a manager. I can absolutely handle this for you. I see your VIP status here, and your satisfaction is our top priority. Let me just pull up your purchase details and review our policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I see here that the VeloBand was delivered 18 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
It means you are well within the return window. I am processing your return for a full refund right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file as we speak.

Yes, absolutely. And for the inconvenience this has caused, as a valued VIP member, I've also gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. We sincerely apologize for the trouble.
Well... okay. A full refund and a credit. That's what you should have done from the start. Fine. Thank you.
You're very welcome. You should see that email in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
